query: Trump job approval tracker Republican base slipping

results.content: ## The president is getting bad news from his base with less than 3 months to the midterms. Donald Trump is getting a major warning from his own party as a string of new polls show Republican support for the president slipping sharply ahead of the midterms. An Economist/YouGov poll released Tuesday put Trump’s approval among Republicans at 79 percent, down 12 points from January 2025. A Financial Times poll found Trump’s net approval among Republicans had fallen eight points in one month, while an ActiVote survey also found Republican approval at 79 percent, down from 86 percent in January 2025. results.content: President Trump’s approval rating dipped again this week, following a downward trend in support for the president amid the ongoing Iran war and mounting affordability concerns ahead of November’s midterms. The latest survey from The Economist/YouGov, published Monday, found 33 percent of respondents said they approved of how Trump has handled his job as president. Support for the president was split largely along partisan lines, with 79 percent of GOP respondents and only 4 percent of Democratic respondents approving of Trump’s job performance, according to the poll. results.content: ## Approval falls to 33% as independents, Hispanics and moderate Republicans drift away, while the Iran war and cost of living threaten GOP control of Congress. Donald Trump’s name will not appear on the ballot when Americans vote on November 3, but the midterm elections are increasingly shaping up as a referendum on his presidency. Less than two years after returning to the White House with a victory that dramatically expanded the Republican coalition, Trump now faces sharp erosion among independent voters, Hispanics and more moderate Republicans, even as his core MAGA base remains overwhelmingly loyal.
